title: IPC Transmit
text: Transmit data to either core while using separate model for each core, 1 input; {Destination}, {Channel} and {Enable blocking} sets the if Core must wait until sent data is read. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Input
ports.summary: Data to be send to the other Core uint16 | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: Destination
params.values: Destination selected to send data C28x (CPU1/CPU2)/CPU1 (default) | ARM Cortex-M4 (CM)/CPU2

params.name: Enable blocking
params.values: Specify if Core must wait until sent data is read off (default) | on
